description: Make the website live through the app’s save API; the server’s final website checks run as part of it (soclo_page_preflight diagnoses them for an exact revision). Free. Without confirm:true it returns a preview only; pass confirm:true only after the owner approves. A lost write reply must be reconciled with soclo_page_get before retrying.

confirm.description: true only after the owner approved the exact change. Omit or pass false to get a preview: nothing is sent.

name: soclo_page_publish
title: Publish the website
